description: Assemble a markdown briefing of the concepts most relevant to a query and/or explicit ids, expanded through the graph and trimmed to a token budget. The briefing is self-contained, so it can be handed to another agent or pasted into a prompt as-is. The final JSON line reports which concept ids were included, whether the bundle was truncated, and its approximate token count. Provide at least one of `query` or `ids`.

depth.description: Graph hops to expand from the seeds (default 1).

ids.description: Explicit seed concept ids (kept first, in order).

product.description: Restrict expansion to concepts of this product.

query.description: Search query used to pick seed concepts.

tokenBudget.description: Approximate token cap for the bundle (chars/4, default 4000).

name: get_context
title: Assemble context bundle
